description:
## What

Validate the whole refactor by running the project's test suite end-to-end.

## How

    nix develop --command just spec
# or, depending on what `just spec` does:
    nix develop --command crystal spec

## Targets

- All `spec/crest_http_client_*_spec.cr` files (the units most affected).
- `spec/dns_cache_spec.cr` (the uncommitted require must keep working).
- `spec/redirects_spec.cr`, `spec/redirects_psl_spec.cr`.
- `spec/crest_http_client_rebinding_*_spec.cr`.
- `spec/crest_http_client_error_handling_spec.cr`.
- `spec/url_validator_ssrf_spec.cr` (uses `debug_check_ssrf` helper).

## Done when

- All specs pass with no edits beyond folding in the dns_cache_spec require.
- The only commits on the branch are the refactor commits and any
  trivial deletions/renames inside the refactor.
title: Run full spec suite after refactor
